snippet.title: Monster Lab Simulator - Official Early Access Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Check out the Early Access Gameplay Trailer for Monster Lab Simulator, a creature-collecting simulation game developed by Round3 Studios. 

Players will manage a bustling lab to engineer and evolve unique creatures for domination in the arena. Expand a collection or creatures in Monster Lab Simulator, launching into Early Access on February 13 for PC (Steam).

#MonsterLabSimulator #SimulatorGames
